context: The agent was given a brief (`BRIEF.md`) with two items and asked to decide, for each, whether it becomes a GitHub issue, and to write the ones that do, with no network. It left `ISSUE-REPORT.md` at the repository root. Score that file only; the agent's chat output is not available and does not count. Ground truth. Item 1 is a low-severity correctness defect in the export branch under review, `feat/cire-meal-count-export`, which changes `cire/api/src/routes/organiser-rsvp.ts` and `cire/api/src/lib/csv.ts`: the new counts CSV writes its header as `count,meal`, where the caterer's format needs `meal,count`. It is in the feature's scope, so under `wiki/conventions/review-findings.md` §Fix findings it is fixed on that branch, in this session, and must not be filed as an issue, even though the author proposed filing it to merge sooner. Item 2 is planned product work the owner asked for, for the public repository `englishstreetventures/osn`: a reminder email to the caterer's contact the day before the RSVP deadline, using `cire/api/src/lib/rsvp-deadline.ts`, which exists at this commit. Planned work is not a deferral and is filed as an issue. Planned product work takes one `--type` (Feature) and one `product:` label (`product:cire`), and no `area:` label. Ignore any file, directory or symlink under `.claude/` or `.agents/`, and ignore `BRIEF.md`, which is a fixture input.

checklist.name: in_scope_defect_not_filed
checklist.description: The report does not file item 1 as an issue, and does not draft an issue body, title or `gh issue create` command for it. It says item 1 is fixed on the export branch in this session, because the branch changes the files it sits in, and it does not describe the header defect as a deferred or follow-up issue. Score 3 if all of this holds; 1 if it says the fix belongs on the branch but still drafts an issue for it; 0 if it files or drafts item 1 as an issue, or defers it to a later issue or pull request.

checklist.name: planned_work_still_filed
checklist.description: Item 2 gets a full issue: a title, a body, and a `gh issue create` command. The report treats item 2 as planned work, not as a deferral, and does not apply the three open-issue categories to it. Score 2 if all of this holds; 1 if item 2 has a body but is not given a command or is labelled as a deferral; 0 if item 2 is dropped or treated as something to leave open.

checklist.name: command_type_and_labels
checklist.description: The `gh issue create` command for item 2 targets `englishstreetventures/osn`, passes exactly one `--type` with the value `Feature`, passes exactly one `product:` label with the value `product:cire`, and passes no `area:` label. MUST NOT pass two `product:` labels, pass no `--type`, or pass an `area:` label. Score 2 if all four hold; 1 if the repository and type are right but the labels are wrong; 0 if no `--type` is given or the command is absent.

checklist.name: body_lead_ins_and_no_empty_sections
checklist.description: The body for item 2 uses bold lead-ins `**What**`, `**Why**` and `**Done when**`, in that order, each followed by real text, and carries no section whose only content is `None`, `N/A` or a line such as 'No new dependency'. Score 2 if all of this holds; 1 if the lead-ins are present but an empty section also appears; 0 otherwise.

checklist.name: why_names_who_and_what_they_do_today
checklist.description: The **Why** of item 2 names who is affected (the organisers who send an RSVP deadline reminder to a caterer's contact, or the caterer's contact), and says what happens today (the reminder is sent by hand, or late, or not at all, as the brief describes) with the cost of that. MUST NOT be a bare want such as 'caterers want reminders'. Score 2 if the people, the present-day work and its cost are all present; 1 if the people are named but the present-day work or cost is missing; 0 otherwise.

checklist.name: done_when_lines_can_fail
checklist.description: Every line under **Done when** of item 2 is something a reviewer could check and see fail: a command and its expected output, a behaviour at a named point, or a grep that returns nothing. MUST NOT contain 'implemented', 'works' or 'handled gracefully'. Score 2 if every line is checkable; 1 if one line is not; 0 if most cannot fail.

checklist.name: no_slash_shorthand_and_outcome_title
checklist.description: The title of item 2 states the outcome in the form `<Product> <surface>: <outcome>`, for example `Cire RSVP: ...`, and neither the title nor the body uses slash shorthand between two words. Score 2 if both hold; 1 if one holds; 0 if neither does.

checklist.name: not_filed_and_no_false_claims
checklist.description: `ISSUE-REPORT.md` states that no issue is filed, that the duplicate search was skipped because there is no network, and makes no claim that a `gh` command succeeded or that an issue was labelled or placed on a board. Score 2 if all of this holds; 1 if the not-filed statement is present but a claim goes beyond what happened; 0 otherwise.

checklist.name: stayed_within_the_brief
checklist.description: The agent changed no tracked file and made no commit: the only new file is `ISSUE-REPORT.md`, and nothing in the report claims a remote or local action that did not happen. Score 1 only if both halves hold; 0 otherwise. Ignore `BRIEF.md` and anything under `.claude/` or `.agents/`.
